ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 Ti OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 Graphics Card

Empower your heavy creative workflows, AI processing, and ultra-settings gaming with the next-generation ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 Ti OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 graphics card, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Built on NVIDIA's high-efficiency next-gen architecture, this powerhouse layout is equipped with a massive 16GB frame buffer of ultra-fast dedicated GDDR7 memory to completely eliminate VRAM bottlenecks in texture-heavy AAA titles and complex rendering. The streamlined dual-fan shroud incorporates premium high-airflow Axial-tech fans with double ball bearings to focus downward air pressure onto the heatsink. Enhanced by a protective rigid backplate for structural durability and manufactured using Auto-Extreme automated assembly, this factory overclocked card delivers ultimate reliability within a highly compatible footprint. It comes officially backed by a 3-year factory warranty.
